alerts.title: Viral load monitoring: confirm 6-monthly schedule and recency
alerts.message: The DTG-based regimen guideline recommends viral load checks every 6 months, with 12-monthly testing only if VL is below 50 copies/mL for over 1 year with reliable adherence. The last recorded viral load was 2025-09-15 (129 days before visit), and the prior was 2024-09-15 (494 days earlier), a gap exceeding 12 months between results. Current VL values are below detection threshold (20 and 30 copies/mL), which is reassuring. The plan today does not mention viral load ordering or scheduling, and no viral load result is recorded since September 2025, so the 6-monthly schedule may be overdue or not documented. Discussion of DSD eligibility is noted, which is conditional on sustained suppression and reliable adherence.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm whether a viral load is due now under the 6-monthly schedule, and document the next VL date. Before any move to 12-monthly testing or DSD, confirm sustained VL below 50 copies/mL for over 1 year with reliable adherence.
